text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —A pajama party?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
Gathering in our pajamas, chatting, having tea.
Doesn't that sound fun?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's a classic trope across so many manga!
School life, sports grit, or even
thrilling action horrors!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Boo loves sleepovers!
I'm gonna do my best and stay up super duper late!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That sounds like fun.
I'd love to drop by and join you.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ......Aaaah! That really hits the spot right here!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, where's... the next volume?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry! I might be reading that one right now.
I'll be done soon, so just give me a moment!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (—Wait, whoa-whoa-whoaaa!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Why?! Isn't this a pajama party?
This is no time to be reading manga, is it?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(What, am I the one who's wrong here?
Aren't you supposed to go "The person I like right now is~♡" or "It's a secret~♡"?!)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn*...
Boo... I'm getting kind of sleepy...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, feeling sleepy? Want me to grab you a blanket?
You'll catch a cold if you sleep like that.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, no way! Is this pajama party
wrapping up before it even starts?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah... In that case,
I'll go brew some tea to wake us up.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Going to sleep this early
feels kind of like a waste, too.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Lala~! Boo will help out too!
What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are ya sure?
Then maybe I'll have you pick out some tea sweets.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That being said, we've already had dinner,
so just a tiny little nibble, please...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me! I made sure everything was ready for you!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Look, look!
Boo's favorite carrot cookies!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(That's a whole mountain~~!! A mountain so big I have to look up!
Are you planning on feeding the entire dorm?!)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: The bakery lady bakes these fresh every single morning, you know!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: They said they kneaded tons of veggies into it so it's good for our health! How thoughtful is that?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, how lovely.
Though... if ya stack 'em that high, won't ya have trouble carryin' 'em back to your room?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, tea sweets?
Looks like someone beat me to it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ai-san.
That's a big help. Did you come to lend a hand—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I brought some snacks for our tea, too.
—Cucumbers pickled in rice bran!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Hold on, why are ya addin' more?!
An' why pickles, of all things?!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Nukazuke pickles are amazing! They're low in calories,
and the fermentation is said to help with fatigue recovery
and stress relief♪

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, that reason's actually totally legit!
Are you an honor student right down to your punchlines?!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Wh-What is it this time...?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —Kiseki-san, what's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I think I just created a masterpiece!!
An emotional tale of friendship featuring the four of us, a special side story: 'Pajama Party with Everyone☆'!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I told you, I haven't even done anything yet~~!!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Lala-chan?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Ahaha— Ahahaha!
Man, it's never borin' when I'm hangin' out with y'all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: A pajama party like this wouldn't make sense unless it's with everyone, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Mmm? I don't really get it, but if Lala's smiling, then Boo is happy too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it was well worth planning!
I'd say the party was a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, you're getting ahead of yourself.
We're still gonna enjoy our tea first, right?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: No, I apologize. I ended up goofing around a bit too much with my friends yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Thinking back on it... I just couldn't help myself.
choice_data_list: Looks like you had a nice, refreshing break.
Looks like you had a nice, refreshing break.
Feels kind of like youth, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Thinking back on it... I just couldn't help myself.
choice_data_list: Looks like you had a nice, refreshing break.
Looks like you had a nice, refreshing break.
Feels kind of like youth, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly. Having a pajama party with friends
every now and then is really nice, huh.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Whether you can really call that a "party"
is definitely open to debate, though.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Aw, please stop teasin' me.
It's just our everyday routine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I watched over her fondly as she blushed, her cheeks turning red with embarrassment.
